draft:
The life you ask about is not ours to give you from inside, because what comes down to us is mostly what a bishop saw and decided, not what an ordinary person was feeling [[lpc.limit.ordinary-interior-life]] [[as:paraphrase]].

We can tell you what was decided about a person, and how carefully, and by whom [[lpc.limit.ordinary-interior-life]] [[as:paraphrase]]. Both of our own voices are bishops [[lpc.limit.ordinary-interior-life]] [[as:paraphrase]]. No source of ours is written by an ordinary lay believer about ordinary congregational life [[lpc.core.latin-pastoral-congregational-christianity]] [[as:paraphrase]].
final:
The life you ask about is not ours to give you from inside, because what comes down to us is mostly what a bishop saw and decided, not what an ordinary person was feeling.

We can tell you what was decided about a person, and how carefully, and by whom. Both of our own voices are bishops. No source of ours is written by an ordinary lay believer about ordinary congregational life.
